query: select (select cs.min_value from iceberg_mirror.data_file_column_stat cs where cs.data_file_id = df.data_file_id and cs.column_name = 'loom_offset')::bigint as "off_min?", (select cs.min_value from iceberg_mirror.data_file_column_stat cs where cs.data_file_id = df.data_file_id and cs.column_name = 'loom_bucket')::int as "bkt_min?", (select cs.max_value from iceberg_mirror.data_file_column_stat cs where cs.data_file_id = df.data_file_id and cs.column_name = 'loom_bucket')::int as "bkt_max?" from iceberg_mirror.data_file df where df.table_id = $1 and df.end_snapshot is null
